mapping_input_policy.input: Human-reviewed PVS-16 ClaimIR only, interpreted under the already-frozen Grammar-v0 role semantics.
mapping_input_policy.note: The frozen evidence profile exists on the base commit, but no evidence-level field is included in this mapping artifact and no mapping verdict is conditioned on E0-E3.

role_semantics.K: typed transformation / dependence; not necessarily functional
role_semantics.T: succession / temporal indexing, distinct from K
role_semantics.rho/O: boundary-relative observation / trace; may include incoming or outgoing information at the Discussion-level grammar

relation_projection_semantics.PRESERVED: The required relation/distinction is retained directly by supported Grammar-v0 roles and typed relation structure without semantic strengthening.
relation_projection_semantics.PARTIAL: Required endpoints/roles are represented, but a first-class predicate, directionality, implementation/null/comparison semantics, or other assertion-level distinction is not fully preserved.
relation_projection_semantics.UNMAPPED: A required endpoint/context or relation cannot be represented losslessly without retyping a frozen ClaimIR element or adding relation/role language.

claim_verdict_rule.PARTIAL: no UNMAPPED relation and at least one PARTIAL relation
